Your frequently asked questions
If you don’t find answers to your questions here, don’t hesitate to ask. Our customer service team is always ready to help.
When it comes to writing a great resume, simply listing your achievements, experiences, and skills is not always enough. To give your resume extra credibility, you should tailor it to each job posting. 
This transforms it from just a list of accomplishments into a mirror of what the employer is looking for. Tailoring your resume and using the right keywords and skills not only makes it more appealing to recruiters but also helps it pass Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) by targeting exactly what the system is designed to find.
Absolutely. Once you’ve created your resume using our AI Resume Builder, you can take it a step further with our Resume Optimization tools. These tools help improve your ATS score, adjust your resume’s structure, and make sure it matches the job description—so you can increase your chances of landing an interview.
The length of your resume can vary depending on your field and stage of career. However, the golden rule we recommend is to keep it to one page. Your resume should be concise, focused, and easy to scan.
Recruiters typically spend only about 6 seconds on each application, and your resume needs to demonstrate your fit right away.
That said, a two-page resume can be acceptable, and for applicants with extensive work experience, even necessary. Just be sure not to exceed two pages.
Absolutely. Building a good resume that can actually land you a job is about much more than just listing your achievements correctly. It requires proper formatting to pass the ATS, a clean template, and the right keywords that match the role you’re applying for.
That’s where a good AI Resume Writer can make a huge difference. It handles all these things for you in just seconds! All that’s left for you is to proofread and tweak it to your liking.
Kickresume AI Resume Writer is based on OpenAI’s GPT-4 neural network which is a powerful language model able to produce texts that are indistinguishable from texts written by human writers.
In other words, the AI Resume Writer does exactly what you’d think it would — automatically writes your resume.

All you have to do is enter your name and job title, click Generate resume with AI and the AI will generate the entire first draft of your resume for you.
It'll write professional sections for your resume summary, work experience, and education, with a consistent tone throughout the document. 
If you don't like some of the content, you can either edit any part or generate each part separately using AI. Just click the AI writer button.
If you like the bullet points but feel like some section is still too short, simply click the AI writer button again and the AI will add more phrases to it.

But naturally, since the text is written by AI and not you, you still need to tweak some details in the end. Nevertheless, it can still help you write your first draft.
Even with a free account, you get a limited number of uses. Every premium subscription (starting at $7/month) includes a substantially higher number of AI requests.
At the beginning of every billing period, credits are added to your account (whether it’s a month, three months, or a year).
GPT-4 is a paid tool and we have to pay Open-AI for every API request. We’re “buying” the use of their AI technology. Because of that, we had to put a limit on how many times you can use the AI Writer per month.
Kickresume’s AI Resume Writer is able to generate your entire resume based on a provided job title.
All you have to do is:

Sign up or log in to your Kickresume account. When logged in, click on My Documents on the top bar, and then click on New resume with AI. 
Fill out your name and your most recent job title, then click Continue.
Pick out the resume design you like.
Done :)
If you don't like some of the content, you can either edit any part or generate each part separately using AI. Just click the AI writer button.
